data_source: Adjusted daily closing prices (Yahoo Finance, with Massive as backfill).
method: Today's holdings and weights are placed at the first day of each episode and held without rebalancing.
A holding that traded through the episode uses its own adjusted closing prices.

A holding with no prices in the episode is reconstructed from its factor loadings and the seven factors' actual daily moves. Loadings are estimated on recent data, so a reconstruction assumes the holding behaved then as it does now.
A holding with neither prices nor loadings is left out and its weight is shown; the other weights are not scaled up.
Factor contributions come from the factor model applied to the realised factor moves; the remainder is what the factors do not explain.
warnings: Option positions are not replayed; this covers the stock book only.
